Overview

Seville is a city in Andalusia with a population of 690,000. The heart of Andalusia with a magnificent Gothic cathedral, the Alcázar palace, flamenco, and passionate culture. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 290 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
